# temps_ai_model_catalog_settings (Resource)

Where the AI gateway's model catalog (models and prices) comes from and how often it is refreshed.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are.

Import with `ai_model_catalog_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `ai_gateway:read`, `ai_gateway:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_ai_model_catalog_settings" "this" {
  auto_refresh           = true
  refresh_interval_hours = 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_refresh` (Boolean) Refresh the catalog on a schedule.
- `discover_provider_models` (Boolean) Also list the models each provider offers.
- `refresh_interval_hours` (Number) Hours between refreshes.
- `source_url` (String) Catalog URL; the default catalog when unset.

### Read-Only

- `effective_source_url` (String) Catalog URL in use.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `ai_model_catalog_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_ai_model_catalog_settings.this ai_model_catalog_settings
```
